title: Replace all service images with professional photos and fix search functionality

requirements.summary: Replace ALL 48+ service card images with real professional photos of technicians performing services
acceptanceCriteria: All 48+ individual service cards display real professional photos of technicians performing that specific service
No cartoon illustrations (like Furniture Repair workshop scene or Door & Window Fixing diagram panels) remain
No blank images, broken image placeholders, or grey placeholders remain
All images use object-fit: cover with consistent dimensions and rounded corners
Each service has a unique, realistic, service-relevant photo

file_operations.description: Update all service image paths to reference the generated professional photos in frontend/public/assets/generated/. Replace cartoon illustrations, blank images, and broken placeholders with realistic service photos. Map each service to its corresponding generated image file (e.g., AC Installation → frontend/public/assets/generated/ac-installation.dim_800x600.png, Tap Repair → frontend/public/assets/generated/tap-repair.dim_800x600.png, Furniture Repair → frontend/public/assets/generated/furniture-repair.dim_800x600.png, Door & Window Fixing → frontend/public/assets/generated/door-window-fixing.dim_800x600.png). Ensure all 48+ services reference real professional photos showing technicians performing the actual service work.

Verify the image rendering uses object-fit: cover with proper rounded corners matching the card design. Ensure consistent aspect ratio and dimensions for all service images. Add fallback handling for missing images to prevent broken placeholders from appearing.

requirements.summary: Fix search bar to filter services in real-time with dropdown results
acceptanceCriteria: Search bar filters services in real-time as user types
Dropdown results appear below the search input showing matching services
Dropdown displays service name, category, and matches query against service description
Clicking a search result navigates to the Services page and highlights or scrolls to that service card
Search dropdown has proper z-index to appear above other elements

file_operations.description: Implement real-time search functionality by connecting the search input to the useSearchServices hook. Display filtered results in a dropdown positioned below the search input with proper z-index (z-50 or higher). Show matching service name, category badge, and description snippet in each dropdown item. Add click handlers to navigate to /services with the selected service ID as a URL parameter or hash. Implement keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter) for the dropdown. Ensure the dropdown closes when clicking outside or selecting a result.

Verify the hook correctly filters services by matching the query against service name, category, and description fields. Ensure debouncing is working properly to avoid excessive re-renders. Return an array of matching services with all necessary fields for display in the dropdown (name, category, description, id).

Add functionality to handle incoming service ID from URL parameters or hash (e.g., /services?service=tap-repair or /services#tap-repair). When a service ID is present, scroll to and highlight the corresponding service card using scrollIntoView with smooth behavior. Apply a temporary highlight animation or border to the target service card to indicate it was selected from search.

requirements.summary: Fix mobile dropdown scrolling with proper touch handling and body scroll prevention
acceptanceCriteria: Service category filter buttons (All, Pest Control, Carpentry, etc.) scroll smoothly on mobile
Service dropdowns on Booking page and Reviews page scroll smoothly without page body scrolling
Dropdowns have max-height: 260px with vertical scroll enabled
Touch-based scrolling is smooth with -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch
Page content behind dropdown does not scroll when dropdown is open on mobile
Dropdown remains open and functional while scrolling its contents

file_operations.description: Fix the horizontal scrolling category filter buttons (All, Pest Control, Carpentry, etc.) for mobile by ensuring the container has proper overflow-x: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, and overscroll-behavior-x: contain. The button container should scroll smoothly without affecting page body scroll on mobile devices.

Fix the service selection dropdown on mobile by applying max-height: 260px, overflow-y: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, overscroll-behavior: contain, and z-index: 9999. Add touch event handlers to prevent body scroll when the dropdown is open. Implement useEffect hook that adds/removes 'overflow-hidden' class to document.body when dropdown opens/closes on mobile. Ensure dropdown remains open while scrolling its contents using stopPropagation on scroll events.

Fix the service filter dropdown on mobile by applying max-height: 260px, overflow-y: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, overscroll-behavior: contain, and z-index: 9999. Add touch event handlers to prevent body scroll when the dropdown is open. Implement useEffect hook that adds/removes 'overflow-hidden' class to document.body when dropdown opens/closes on mobile. Ensure dropdown remains open while scrolling its contents using stopPropagation on scroll events.

Apply the same mobile dropdown fix to the search results dropdown if it hasn't been addressed in REQ-39. Ensure max-height: 260px, overflow-y: auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, overscroll-behavior: contain, and z-index: 9999. Prevent body scroll when dropdown is open on mobile devices.

requirements.summary: Integrate generated professional service photos into service cards
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are saved to frontend/public/assets/generated/ directory
Each generated image shows a realistic technician performing the specific service
Generated images have appropriate dimensions (minimum 600x400px) for service cards
Images are properly integrated into service card components replacing placeholders
All generated images maintain consistent quality and professional appearance

file_operations.description: Wire the 16 generated professional service photos from frontend/public/assets/generated/ into the services data structure. Map the following generated images to their respective services: frontend/public/assets/generated/ac-installation.dim_800x600.png for AC Installation, frontend/public/assets/generated/ac-gas-refill.dim_800x600.png for AC Gas Refill, frontend/public/assets/generated/tap-repair.dim_800x600.png for Tap Repair, frontend/public/assets/generated/furniture-repair.dim_800x600.png for Furniture Repair, frontend/public/assets/generated/door-window-fixing.dim_800x600.png for Door & Window Fixing, frontend/public/assets/generated/washing-machine-repair.dim_800x600.png for Washing Machine Repair, frontend/public/assets/generated/refrigerator-repair.dim_800x600.png for Refrigerator Repair, frontend/public/assets/generated/microwave-repair.dim_800x600.png for Microwave Repair, frontend/public/assets/generated/water-purifier-service.dim_800x600.png for Water Purifier Service, frontend/public/assets/generated/pipe-leakage.dim_800x600.png for Pipe Leakage, frontend/public/assets/generated/bathroom-plumbing.dim_800x600.png for Bathroom Plumbing, frontend/public/assets/generated/motor-installation.dim_800x600.png for Motor Installation, frontend/public/assets/generated/interior-painting.dim_800x600.png for Interior Painting, frontend/public/assets/generated/exterior-painting.dim_800x600.png for Exterior Painting, frontend/public/assets/generated/wall-putty.dim_800x600.png for Wall Putty, frontend/public/assets/generated/texture-painting.dim_800x600.png for Texture Painting. For any remaining services not covered by the 16 generated images, use existing realistic photos from the assets/generated/ directory as appropriate (e.g., pest-control-tech.dim_800x600.png, carpenter-working.dim_800x600.png, electrician-wiring.dim_800x600.png, plumber-pipes.dim_800x600.png, home-cleaning.dim_800x600.png). Ensure every service references a real professional photo showing a technician performing that specific service.
